ignore.label: the title logo's colour waves move on once for every 20 updates of the title screen; the original loads on a thread, the title runs about 4000 updates in its first 300 frames, the port loads in the main thread and the title runs one update a frame, so the two logos are in other phases (the port's waves equal the original's for the same count of updates, checked by fitting both pictures to the same formula)

the loading bar and its text: the original is still loading in its thread at frame 300 (the bar part full, 'Paging Dr. Atomicus...'), the port loads in the main thread and has finished; the same picture of the finished load is compared in t1000.png

the halo of a molecule that has just formed: the original's Draw shakes it by random numbers (0x413880, the game's generator, three draws a member each frame), so its offsets depend on how many frames were drawn before; the port draws the same with its own count, which no input can line up (the draws are a function of the frame rate, not of the game state)
